message.content: {"note_claim": "Persona 3 Reload's water UI theme reflects the original game's design intent evoking water and bubbles, enhanced to symbolize sinking into the Sea of Souls and seaside locations like Port Island.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Ever since the original version, I've been impressed by the beautiful blue color and movement reminiscent of water and bubbles. When I talked to the staff who worked on the original game before starting on P3R, I found out that they had actually created the UI with that image in mind.", "reason": "The page directly quotes the art director confirming the original game's water/bubble design intent and, elsewhere, explicitly mentions combining 'the beauty of the sea from Port Island' with the protagonist's 'Sea of Souls' and the imagery of sinking."}

parsed.note_claim: Persona 3 Reload's water UI theme reflects the original game's design intent evoking water and bubbles, enhanced to symbolize sinking into the Sea of Souls and seaside locations like Port Island.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ever since the original version, I've been impressed by the beautiful blue color and movement reminiscent of water and bubbles. When I talked to the staff who worked on the original game before starting on P3R, I found out that they had actually created the UI with that image in mind.
parsed.reason: The page directly quotes the art director confirming the original game's water/bubble design intent and, elsewhere, explicitly mentions combining 'the beauty of the sea from Port Island' with the protagonist's 'Sea of Souls' and the imagery of sinking.
